title.narrative: Supporting food security in the Republic of Chad

description.narrative: (54,855) families received food aid to fill the gap in IPC reports
Helping to close the food and nutrition gap in the latest IPC report issued in the Republic of Chad (by 13% in targeted areas)

This project aims to provide vulnerable families in Chad with sufficient food supplies to meet their basic food needs, which contributes to preventing the worsening of food insecurity and thus saving more lives and reducing displacement and the phenomenon of begging. A total of (54,855) food baskets will be distributed, divided into 3 distribution cycles. During the project duration, a distribution cycle of every two months.
